source: Etsy stack: Owned Channel Operating Playbook v3.0 §4.1, verified against https://www.etsy.com/legal/fees/ on or before 2026-10-21. Payhip: owner-confirmed from the live account on 2026-10-22 (Payhip charges no processing rate of its own; Stripe US standard 2.9% + $0.30 applies, plus Payhip's 5% Free-plan fee).

etsy.notes: Transaction fee applies to price + shipping + gift wrap, not US sales tax. Processing applies to the total incl. tax and shipping.

payhip.notes: 5% is the Free-plan platform fee. 2.9% + $0.30 is Stripe US standard processing, confirmed by the owner on 2026-10-22. PayPal checkout uses PayPal's own rate, not modeled here; re-snapshot if PayPal is enabled.

one_time.notes: Paid once at Etsy shop opening (owner-reported 2026-10-22). Counts toward Day 0 cash, not per-sale fees.
